free_tier.stated: the app downloads and runs local models on the user's own hardware; the local endpoint serves them free of per-token charges; LM Studio also lists 9 cloud models on its catalog but those are separate paid offers

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: the LM Studio desktop app (Bionic agent) and a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint at 127.0.0.1:1234/v1
chaining: pairs with an agent through the local endpoint only; the scarce link is the hardware the reader supplies
binding_note: local inference has no hosted quota; the constraint is the user's machine

identity_cost.detail: no account is needed for local models; the app is downloaded and runs on the user's machine

reliability_note: no reliability event stated on the first-party page

evidence.proved: the app is local and natively runs open models
evidence.quote: Natively local. Built for creativity, work, and code.

notes: record for the LMStudio offer; verdict qualifies-with-caveat, confidence documented
